start_url.description: Bloom & Co. site base URL, without a trailing slash, for booking browser tests.

customer_name.description: Valid test customer name with at least two letters, for successful and setup bookings.

customer_phone.description: Valid test customer phone of 7–15 digits, optionally formatted with spaces, dashes or leading +.

eligible_booking_code.description: Code of a live customer booking made with customer_phone, starting more than 24 hours from the test and having a stylist slot suitable for availability checks.

late_booking_code.description: Code of a live customer booking made with customer_phone, starting less than 24 hours from the test.

cutoff_booking_code.description: Code of a live customer booking made with customer_phone whose start is exactly 24 hours after test execution; keep the time fixture synchronized with the run.
